title: content-backport
description: Backporting content from newer versions with high fidelity - probably
body:
# About
A quick, dirty and otherwise unfinished NeoForge 1.21.1 mod that backports player-visible content from later Minecraft
versions (blocks, items, mobs, worldgen, biome / sound / look variants).
Vanilla namespaces (`minecraft:`) are preserved wherever the
upstream content does in the hopes when updating items and blocks shouldn't disappear.

I originally created this mod for a friend's server because nearly every backport mod was either bad, or used MCreator. 
This most is pure distilled Mojang code, mixed and adapted to 1.21.1 whenever possible.

I'm deciding to publish this mod now before it rots forever in my HDD. 
Won't be publishing it as open source because its code lives in an odd state of being heavily derived from Minecraft's code,
but Modified enough where it is its own thing.

If there's any other feature that should be backported shoot me a message whichever place you find that can be used
to direct a message to me.

### 1.21.2: Bundles of Bravery

| Category        | Content                                                         |
|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|
| Damage types    | `mace_smash` + `mace_smash` tag, havent wired up it yet I think |
| Banner patterns | `bordure_indented`, `field_masoned`, have not tested this       |

### 1.21.4: The Garden Awakens (Pale Garden)

| Category          | Content                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|-------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Biome             | `pale_garden`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Entity            | Creaking (+ spawn egg, loot table, AI (Yes it actually acts like the creaking and it is NOT a generic mob!))                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Wood family       | Pale Oak: planks, log, stripped log, wood, stripped wood, leaves, sapling (+ potted), stairs, slab, fence, fence gate, door, trapdoor, button, pressure plate, sign, wall sign, hanging sign, wall hanging sign, boat, chest boat                                                                       |
| Resin family      | Resin clump, resin block, resin brick (item), resin bricks, brick stairs / slab / wall, chiseled resin bricks                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Trim material     | `resin`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Flora             | Open / closed eyeblossom (+ potted), bush, cactus flower, wildflowers, firefly bush, short / tall dry grass, leaf litter, pale moss block / carpet / hanging moss                                                                                                                                       |
| Worldgen features | Fallen trees (oak, birch, jungle, spruce, super birch), leaf-litter tree variants (birch, oak, dark oak, fancy oak), `patch_dry_grass`, `patch_bush`, `patch_firefly_bush`, `patch_leaf_litter`, pale garden vegetation / flowers / moss patches, pale oak (incl. creaking variant), wildflower patches |
| Recipes           | Pale Oak wood family, resin family, leaf litter, pale moss carpet, resin clump, banner patterns, dyes from closed / open eyeblossom, pink dye from cactus flower, yellow dye from wildflowers                                                                                                           |
| Colormaps         | `dry_foliage`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

### 1.21.5: Spring to Life

| Category             | Content                                                             |
|----------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Mob variants (biome) | Cow, Pig, Chicken: `cold` / `temperate` / `warm`                    |
| Wolf sound variants  | `classic`, `angry`, `big`, `cute`, `grumpy`, `puglin`, `sad`        |
| Items                | Blue Egg, Brown Egg (laid by cold / warm chickens (I think, maybe)) |

### 1.21.6: Chase the Skies

| Category    | Content |
|-------------|---------|
| Music discs | `tears` |

### 1.21.7: Hotfix / Minecraft movie content

| Category          | Content                                   |
|-------------------|-------------------------------------------|
| Music discs       | `lava_chicken`                            |
| Painting variants | `dennis`, likely missing translation keys |


Wandering trader also sells some stuff in case you add this mod on an already existing world which does not apply the new world gen settings.
